name: Ane Senshi Fiona Shokushu no Wana
original_name: 姉戦士フィオーナ 触手の罠
source:
Fiona becomes a bounty hunter to pay for her sister's medical treatment. Her first dispatch is to vanquish a goblin.

However, the very acceptance of the dispatch was a violatory tentacle trap.

This is the visual novel of the downfall of a bikini armor-clad female warrior.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063926.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
菲奥娜成为一名赏金猎人，以支付姐姐的医疗费用。她的第一个任务是击败妖精。

然而，接受派遣本身就是一个违规的触手陷阱。

这是一部讲述比基尼铠甲女战士垮台的视觉小说。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063926.html]DLsite English[/url]]
